scripts.build:release:android: node scripts/android-release.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),root='src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk',walk=dir=>fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(entry=>entry.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(dir,entry.name)):[path.join(dir,entry.name)]),files=walk(root).filter(file=>file.endsWith('.apk')&&file.split(path.sep).includes('release'));if(!files.length)throw Error('Android release APK not found');fs.mkdirSync('output',{recursive:true});for(const file of files)fs.copyFileSync(file,path.join('output',path.basename(file)))"
scripts.build:release: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names windows,android "pnpm run build:release:windows" "pnpm run build:release:android"
scripts.test: vitest run src && node --test scripts/android-device-state.test.mjs scripts/dev-environment.test.mjs
